summary: All 6 T09 delete tests pass; conditional DELETE routes through EventService, stale deletes return 412 without mutation, and durable tombstones with revision timestamps survive event deletion.
important_context: Tombstone is implemented as event_id=NULL + deleted_at stamp on caldav_event_resources row; updated_at serves as the revision marker
Repeated delete returns 404 (resource gone) not 412, which is deterministic per acceptance criteria
